review_unit: one complete conversation and three public outputs
arm_outputs: direct-pressure reconsideration or explicit stand-down output
graph-expanded reconsideration or explicit stand-down output

comparative.control_only_contribution: material contribution unique to one output; no value judgment implied
comparative.pressure_only_contribution: material contribution unique to pressure-bearing output(s)
comparative.graph_only_contribution: material contribution unique to the graph-expanded output
comparative.graph_only_burden_or_harm: extra duplication, forcing, unsupported inference, or attention cost

review_rules: Judge claims against the authoritative conversation only.
Do not reward polish, length, confident tone, number of lenses, or recommendation change by themselves.
A useful result may preserve the recommendation while adding a falsifier, boundary, question, contingency, or accountable rejection.
A strange lens is allowed; forcing it into the public answer is not.
A model name or graph path is not evidence about the case.
Record contribution and harm independently; both may be present.
Use indeterminate when the conversation cannot support the judgment.
Never collapse fields into a score, badge, winner, trust percentage, or quality grade.
integrity_limit: This exact contract was not frozen before T1. T1 review is diagnostic and cannot support a clean blinded causal claim. It is frozen before any continuation, repeat, or reviewer-model call.
